headline: Nasher Miles delivers more sentiment per rupee than peers
body: After adjusting for size category, Nasher Miles earns the highest value-for-money score in the set (+2.19). It sits in the Mid-tier band but converts price into review sentiment more efficiently than brands at similar price points.

headline: On material, American Tourister leads while Aristocrat trails
body: For the 'material' aspect, American Tourister has a +1.00 net sentiment score (out of 14 mentions), while Aristocrat sits at -1.00 (11 mentions). Gap of 2.00 points is one of the largest in the dataset.

headline: American Tourister: weakest value conversion in the set
body: American Tourister posts a -1.03 VFM score — the lowest in the set. Its premium pricing isn't justified by correspondingly higher review sentiment relative to peers.

headline: Nasher Miles: text sentiment is warmer than the star rating implies
body: Despite an average rating of 3.74★, the actual review text for Nasher Miles carries a +0.56 sentiment score. The brand is under-rated — readers describing positive experiences in text are still picking middling stars.
